changes: Project type/date/list controls share one toolbar row with Export and actions.
Newest-first ordering is unconditional; manual sorting and reordering actions are removed.
Standalone Inbox/Captions Note editor button removed; project notes and quick capture drafts preserved.

ProjectWorkspaceStateTests.summary: PASS: 265 project-workspace checks; stable ordering, scoped selection, complete project counts, backup-compatible persistence, atomic task conversion, inherited ownership and guarded undo.

ProjectWorkspaceExportTests.summary: PASS: 49 project ZIP, ordering, metadata, notes, scope, safe publication, missing-original, and private clipboard checks

ProjectWorkspaceCardTests.summary: PASS: 782 project card checks; Task/Note/Capture semantics, real live task updates, light/dark/grid/320-point compact fixtures, original previews and independent selection; no personal archive, clipboard, network, or external opening.

NavigationHistoryTests.summary: PASS: 123 bounded history, branch, project, draft, search, deletion and navigation safety checks

WorkspaceWindowTests.summary: PASS: 327 native workspace interaction and responsive layout checks

LocalFileLocationTests.summary: PASS: 94 local-folder resolution, project scope, native button, read-only byte preservation, and failure-feedback checks

WorkspaceZoomLayoutTests.summary: PASS: 806 workspace zoom layout checks; finite metrics, logical columns, pointer/item anchoring, history offset, native cards at 75/100/150/200%

ProjectBrowsingNavigationTests.summary: PASS: 74 native project browsing checks; real Board All/Unfiled/named history, native cross-project Notes/retry, late-blocked selection/creation and metadata-filing isolation

ProjectWorkspaceViewTests.summary: PASS: 476 project workspace UI checks; 1,000 synthetic text captures plus image and editable project note; native mixed-selection drag payloads on a private pasteboard; no personal archive, network, general clipboard or external opening. At most 27 simultaneously materialized native rows.
